Use this shard to arcanize the gloves you have equipped.

This type of shard allows casting Divine Touch once per combat.

Does not stack with identical shards.

Use this shard to arcanize the cloak you have equipped.

This type of shard grants [1] temporary Hit Points to allies within [2] when you cast a levelled Abjuration spell.

Stacks with identical shards.

When the wearer casts a levelled Abjuration spell, allies within [2] gain [1] temporary Hit Points.

Stacks with identical shards.

The wearer can reroll a failed Saving Throw. Once per combat.

Does not stack with identical shards.

This weapon's melee attack range is increased by [1]. Spells that strike in melee reach as far while the weapon is in your main hand.

Stacks with identical shards.

Use this shard to arcanize the weapon equipped in your main hand. If no melee weapon is equipped, the ranged weapon in your main hand will be arcanized instead.

This type of shard breaks the target's Concentration on hit.

Does not stack with identical shards.

On hit, this weapon breaks the target's Concentration.

Does not stack with identical shards.
